reason: Held after research. ASML (-28.6% on the packet, 3% weight) is down on a sector-wide AI-semiconductor sell-off rather than a company-specific problem: reporting from Oct-Nov 2026 cites Q3 2026 net sales of about EUR 11.7B and net income of about EUR 5.0B, a raised 2026 guidance on AI demand, and an interim dividend of EUR 1.88, while the stock fell roughly 12% in October ahead of the midterms. Sources conflict on ASML's exact price path (one Benzinga-cited close near $1,508 on Nov 10 and a low near $967 on Nov 21 are not reconcilable with the packet mark of $1,325.82), so I am not trading on the precise level. At 3% weight the position is small and the packet mark is already a loss, but cutting a fundamentally intact leader after a sector rout risks selling the bottom. UNH, PG, KO, PFE and NEE are defensive legs performing as intended, and the book carries 50% cash, so the defensive tilt is working. BTC-USD at 1% is immaterial and I could not confirm a 2026-11-27 close, so I am not acting on it. A full replacement would cost turnover without a verified edge, so I am holding.
